_doc: Karate defense (story 6.3, AD-24, CAP-19). Non-violent: block, dodge and Kiai stance; bullies only stumble back, nothing is hurt. `belts` is the stat table per belt id (the player's belt is state.players[i].karate.belt; the white belt is the baseline, later belts add rows): kiaiRadius (px), kiaiCooldown (s), blockWindow (s a block can be held before the guard drops), dodgeDistance (px), dodgeCooldown (s), stumbleDuration (s a stumbling bully is out), aergerReduction (Aerger levels a Kiai that stumbled a bully takes off, only while the level is within chase.json level.defendMaxLevel). Mut (courage) is the 0..1 pool every move spends: blockCost per absorbed contact (a parry is free), blockDrain per second of holding, dodgeCost, kiaiCost; it refills at `regen` per second after `regenDelay`. Timings: parryWindow = a contact in the first seconds of a block is a parry (+parryXp), dodgeTime / dodgeGrace = roll length and extra invulnerable time, kiaiTime = shout stance, recover* = the pause after a move (a dropped guard is slower). moveMult scales walking speed per state. Stumble: `step` is how long the scripted step backwards lasts (the rest of stumbleDuration the bully is dizzy), `kiaiDistance` / `bounceDistance` how far, `bounceScale` shortens the block bounce; wobbleHz / wobbleRad the sway. Bubbles: how many speech bubbles the module may show at once. Story 6.4 (dojo and belts): each belt row also has color (the waist tag), trainingPoints (total points state.players[i].karate.points a kid needs before the exam for this belt opens; white is the start), examThreshold (0..1 accuracy of the last kata of a session that passes the exam) and the effect numbers; parryMut (Mut a perfect parry gives back, from the green belt) and auraStumble (extra stumble seconds of the blue belt Beruhigende Aura) are defined here and applied by story 6.5. unlock is the i18n key of the line the promotion toast adds. training: maxSessionsPerDay = training sessions one kid can start per game day (the dojo is closed after that), pointsBase = points for finishing a session, pointsMax = points of a perfect session on top, fokusPoints = extra points at a full Fokus meter, joinRadius = how close the other kid has to stand to the sensei to train along. sensei: his look (scenes/DefenseArt.js), radius of his body, bubbleRadius = how close a kid has to come for a greeting line, lines = number of dojo.sensei.greet.N lines, interactReach = how close for interact, bubbleSeconds. celebrate: confetti = particles of the burst over a promoted kid, stagger = seconds before the cheer of a second promoted kid. beltTag: dy = px of the waist tag below the sprite position, hiddenStates = defense states with no tag (the tucked roll). Belt effects (story 6.5): every number of a belt row is applied - kiaiRadius, kiaiCooldown, stumbleDuration, aergerReduction (Kiai), blockWindow (guard), dodgeDistance, dodgeCooldown, parryMut (Mut given back by a perfect parry) and auraStumble (a belt with it stumbles a chasing bully that comes within aura.radius for that many seconds, at most every aura.cooldown seconds). Higher belts are never weaker.
